messages:
Sam (PM): Quick QA note: several 'Docs' links from the Console open the docs root. Support getting tickets. Can we deep-link reliably?

Ravi (Design): I saw this. The sidecar links are generic and mobile hides anchors under the sticky header. UX: need stable anchors + scroll offset.

Leah (Docs): Root cause: anchors are generated from headings so they change when copy edits. Proposal: authors add explicit kebab-case IDs like `### Rate limits {#rate-limits}`.

Priya (Support): If we standardize, I can update KB canned replies. Please confirm canonical link format.

Sam (PM): Canonical format: `https://docs.redwood.inference/console/<page>#<kebab-anchor>` — put in PR descriptions.

Ravi (Design): UX details: when jumping to an anchor do a 72px offset, `element.tabIndex = -1; element.focus()` and respect `prefers-reduced-motion` for scroll. Also add a tiny highlight animation.

Leah (Docs): I'll add explicit IDs to top pages and a small redirect table for renamed anchors. I'll include examples in the PR. CI should warn if a referenced anchor is missing.

DevExBot: Action created: docs-stable-anchors (Leah), ui-offset-scroll (Ravi), support-kb-updates (Priya).

Priya (Support): For runtime when anchor missing: fallback = open docs home + show toast: "Section moved — opening Console docs home" with search link. Make toast keyboard dismissible and SR-friendly.

Ravi (Design): Microcopy for inline link tooltip: "Open docs for this control (new tab)". Sidecar can also fetch short preview via API.

Leah (Docs): Agree on preview API contract: `GET /api/docs/preview?page=<page>&anchor=<anchor>` returns title + 1-line excerpt. Cache TTL 24h. If 404, console shows fallback toast.

Sam (PM): Owners: Leah = anchors + redirects, Ravi = offset + microcopy + preview UI, Priya = KB. QA: add test case for 3 deep links (desktop + mobile + SR) to validate landing and focus.

Ravi (Design): I'll prototype the scroll offset and tooltip tomorrow.

Leah (Docs): I'll open the anchor PR with canonical link examples by EOW.

Sam (PM): Thanks team. Ping when QA ticket exists and we'll ship a small console patch.
